advisory-collector.job: Collect leased NuGet / OSV advisory working state
outputs: frozen OSV advisory data in Security Definitions
advisory-collector.purpose: Query/freeze advisory intelligence for exact NuGet package/version pairs observed in current evidence.
advisory-collector.step: Query OSV for the exact retained NuGet package/version set
advisory-collector.title: NuGet / OSV advisory collector

catalog-freeze.job: Freeze coherent state and build the Omega client DB once
outputs: Omega marketplace database only when semantic freeze changes
catalog-freeze.purpose: Consume settled collection state and current Evidence-v2 at an explicit release boundary; unchanged semantic freezes are no-ops and collector activity cannot invoke this node.
catalog-freeze.step: Validate settled lane inputs and compute semantic catalog-freeze identity
catalog-freeze.title: Catalog freeze and client publication

deep-scan-worker.purpose: Execute an approved bounded deep-analysis profile selected from the durable Stigma-1 analysis-request queue.
deep-scan-worker.title: Deep Scan worker

evidence-publication.job: Process bounded Sigmascope batch against frozen daily inputs
evidence-publication.purpose: Publish a validated candidate as the new coherent Security Evidence v2 snapshot while preserving last-known-good state on failure.
evidence-publication.step: Publish validated Security Evidence v2 snapshot atomically
evidence-publication.title: Evidence publication

inputs: public GitHub repository heads for automated-safe sources
external-analysis-sources.job: Collect leased external-analysis source working state
external-analysis-sources.purpose: Refresh the external analyzer research-source registry and observe only license-allowed public source HEADs; restricted sources remain metadata-only and never become runtime rule feeds.
external-analysis-sources.title: External analyzer research-source observer

manifest-normalization.job: Collect leased manifest enrichment working state
manifest-normalization.purpose: Fetch discovered PluginMaster feeds and normalize plugin manifests into one catalog input model.
manifest-normalization.step: Enrich manifests from the settled discovery result
manifest-normalization.title: Manifest normalization

secondary-security-definitions.purpose: Refresh ClamAV definition assets independently of catalog freeze and retain a previous valid frozen asset when upstream refresh fails.
secondary-security-definitions.step: Refresh and freeze content-addressed secondary-security assets
secondary-security-definitions.title: Secondary-security definition refresh

security-work-reconciler.job: Settle, reconcile, lease and dispatch collector work
security-work-reconciler.purpose: Act as the sole durable collection-queue mutator: settle exact lease-bound results, recover expired leases, enqueue due work and dispatch newly leased workers without catalog-freeze or client-publication authority.
security-work-reconciler.step: Reconcile completed results and create exact leases
security-work-reconciler.title: Security collection work reconciler

sigmascope-authenticode.purpose: Validate embedded PE Authenticode signatures for one exact broker-bound artifact on a Windows runner without executing plugin binaries.
sigmascope-authenticode.step: Collect Authenticode observations with Windows trust APIs
sigmascope-authenticode.title: SigmaScope Windows Authenticode validation

sigmascope-batch.job: Process bounded Sigmascope batch against frozen daily inputs
sigmascope-batch.purpose: Acquire due artifacts/source evidence and produce bounded immutable analyses plus current Evidence-v2 projections.
sigmascope-batch.step: Examine bounded due-variant batch and build Evidence v2 candidate
sigmascope-batch.title: SigmaScope artifact / source analysis

inputs: exact elfBinaryStructure or machOBinaryStructure analysis request
sigmascope-native-structure.job: Collect exact ELF and Mach-O structural observations
sigmascope-native-structure.purpose: Parse one exact broker-bound artifact for bounded ELF/Mach-O loader, dependency, symbol and hardening structure without executing native code.
sigmascope-native-structure.title: SigmaScope ELF / Mach-O structural analysis

sigmascope-parallel-candidate-merger.job: Build validated serialized Evidence-v2 candidate without publication
sigmascope-parallel-candidate-merger.purpose: Apply bounded variant-local worker results over one exact Evidence-v2 base, reconstruct the working database, rebuild global indexes/SRL projections, reproduce source-followup and Deep Scan queue side effects, and intrinsically validate a candidate while retaining zero publication authority.
sigmascope-parallel-candidate-merger.step: Apply disjoint result bundles and rebuild global Evidence-v2 projections centrally
sigmascope-parallel-candidate-merger.title: SigmaScope serialized Evidence-v2 candidate merger (shadow)

sigmascope-parallel-equivalence-prefligh.job: Prove parallel candidate equivalence against serialized reference
sigmascope-parallel-equivalence-prefligh.purpose: Run the same exact queue assignments through a serialized reference, compare affected variant/queue/SRL/Deep Scan/source-followup semantics, then require intrinsic validation, independent developer audit and storage audit before labeling the candidate publishable. This node cannot publish Evidence-v2.
sigmascope-parallel-equivalence-prefligh.step: Compare security semantics and assemble no-authority publication-readiness gates
sigmascope-parallel-equivalence-prefligh.title: SigmaScope serialized equivalence and publication preflight (shadow)

sigmascope-parallel-merge-plan.job: Validate parallel result bundles against one Evidence-v2 base head
sigmascope-parallel-merge-plan.purpose: Validate result-bundle integrity, exact Evidence-v2 base binding, queue-key uniqueness and variant disjointness before a future serialized Evidence-v2 merger is allowed to apply worker results.
sigmascope-parallel-merge-plan.title: SigmaScope parallel merge-plan validator (shadow)

sigmascope-parallel-one-writer-publisher.job: Publish authorized Evidence first, then deferred side effects
sigmascope-parallel-one-writer-publisher.purpose: Reconstruct an exact successful Phase-4B candidate under read-only authority, bind it to the still-current Evidence Git parent, then give one tiny serialized writer the ability to fast-forward Evidence-v2 before publishing Deep Scan state and reconciling source follow-up issues. The existing serialized SigmaScope worker remains the production fallback during cutover.
sigmascope-parallel-one-writer-publisher.step: Publish exact authorized Security Evidence v2 child
sigmascope-parallel-one-writer-publisher.title: SigmaScope parallel one-writer Evidence publication (manual cutover)

sigmascope-parallel-result-worker.job: Run one exact persistent queue key as a result-only worker
sigmascope-parallel-result-worker.purpose: Execute one exact artifact/source queue key against a frozen Definitions worker and the current Evidence-v2 head, producing a bounded content-addressed variant-local result bundle without Evidence-v2 publication authority.
sigmascope-parallel-result-worker.step: Execute exact frozen queue work and emit immutable result bundle
sigmascope-parallel-result-worker.title: SigmaScope parallel result worker (shadow)

source-discovery.job: Collect leased catalog discovery working state

legacyContracts.step: Discover curated, Puni.sh and GitHub PluginMaster sources

source-discovery.purpose: Run the first-class Omega Discovery component: source search, project-page links, issue hints, optional web search, rotating repository-tree inspection and PluginMaster validation.
source-discovery.step: Run typed discovery collectors for the exact durable lease
source-discovery.title: Omega Discovery / source intelligence

source-followup.implementation: source follow-up projection in the frozen SigmaScope worker
source-followup.job: Process bounded Sigmascope batch against frozen daily inputs
source-followup.purpose: Project source attribution/re-analysis follow-ups from artifact results and source-observation changes.
source-followup.title: Public source follow-up

source-revision-observer.job: Collect leased source HEAD working state
source-revision-observer.purpose: Observe public repository HEAD revisions so source changes can invalidate attribution/source-analysis work deterministically.
source-revision-observer.step: Observe public source HEAD revisions without fetching source bodies
source-revision-observer.title: Source revision observer

threat-intelligence.job: Collect leased endpoint threat-intelligence working state
threat-intelligence.purpose: Fetch frozen URL/domain/IP threat indicators, resolve currently observed endpoint hosts, and retain deterministic match provenance for SRL reprojection.
threat-intelligence.title: Endpoint threat-intelligence collector

website-enrichment.job: Collect leased website scraper working state
website-enrichment.purpose: Refresh bounded public project-page metadata while reusing still-fresh cached enrichment.
website-enrichment.step: Reuse fresh page state and scrape only new/stale project pages
website-enrichment.title: Website / project enrichment
